title: MLX Server Version
description: Select the mlx-server binary version to use. Versions are fetched from the [release page](https://github.com/thewulf7/honza/releases) and cached locally.

title: Context Size
description: Maximum output tokens per request. Also used as the default max_tokens when not specified by the client.

title: KV Cache Quantization
description: Quantize the KV cache to reduce memory usage for long contexts. 4-bit saves ~4× memory vs unquantized; 8-bit saves ~2×. Recommended for large contexts (16K+).

title: Max KV Cache Tokens
description: Maximum number of tokens kept in the KV cache. When exceeded, oldest tokens (except the first 4) are evicted. Set to 0 for unlimited. Useful on memory-constrained devices.

title: Prefill Step Size
description: Number of prompt tokens processed per GPU step during prefill (equivalent to llama.cpp ubatch-size). Larger values may be faster but use more memory. Default: 512.

title: GPU Memory Limit (GB)
description: Hard cap on GPU memory usage. Set to 0 to use the system default (1.5× Metal recommended working set). Useful to prevent OOM on devices with limited unified memory.

title: Timeout
description: MLX model load and inference timeout in seconds.

title: Auto unload model
description: Automatically unload other models when loading a new one
